description: This Java class implements the service logic for managing locks on loan accounts within a financial application, including methods for applying, upgrading, and querying locks, and handling batch operations.

classes.name: LoanLockingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the LoanLockingService interface, providing methods to lock, unlock, and query loan account locks, with batch and individual operations.

methods.name: upgradeLock
methods.description: Updates the lock version and owner for a list of loan account IDs.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdIn
methods.description: Retrieves all LoanAccountLock objects for a list of loan IDs.

methods.name: findByLoanIdAndLockOwner
methods.description: Finds a lock by loan ID and owner, logs a warning if not found.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdInAndLockOwner
methods.description: Retrieves all LoanAccountLock objects for a list of loan IDs and a specific lock owner.

methods.name: applyLock
methods.description: Applies a lock to a list of loan IDs for a specified lock owner, using batch insert.

methods.name: deleteByLoanIdInAndLockOwner
methods.description: Deletes locks for a list of loan IDs and lock owner.

methods.name: getInClauseParameterSizeLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the configured maximum size for SQL IN clause parameters.
